description: Update the supplied caption and/or hashtags of one existing saved draft. Pass its postId, current expectedRevision, draftPatch and stable clientRequestId. Without confirm:true, return the proposed patch; with confirm:true, save it only if the post is still a draft at that revision, then return the save receipt and current draft. This does not generate text, change media, schedule or publish posts. Free; needs plan:create.

confirm.description: true only after the owner agreed to cancel that exact post. Omit or pass false to get a preview instead: nothing is cancelled and nothing else is fetched.

name: soclo_posts_edit_draft
title: Edit a saved post draft
